title: 霜尽鹿门

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮粗看：单只白鹿从左向右迈步穿门，左侧冰枝、右侧嫩芽、水路与低处旧头骨均可辨，门前岩路连续到底；未做统一复核。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque full-frame tarot card master for later holographic card production
Primary request: Create ONE original opaque full-frame 1024x1536 vertical Death tarot master, theme 霜尽鹿门 / Frost's End Deer Gate. This is a peaceful transformation image with no disaster or violence.
Input images: Image 1 is an identity, symbolism, and painterly tarot-style reference only; create a new composition.
Subject: exactly ONE elegant white stag with large natural antlers, walking credibly from LEFT to RIGHT through a weathered frost-stone arch. Show a believable walking gait with hooves contacting a solid road; no other deer or living animals.
Scene/backdrop: the LEFT side is winter-dormant with icy bare branches; the RIGHT side shows melting snow and fresh green buds. A narrow waterway continues behind the arch into the distance. Include exactly ONE small old weathered animal skull low at the far lower-left edge, subdued and partly nestled among stones, never prominent and never shaped as another animal.
Composition/framing: stag crosses left-to-right beneath the arch; left icy branches, right fresh buds, water route receding. A complete broad rocky road in front of the gate supports every hoof and extends continuously to the bottom bleed. The arch belongs to the background. Fine frost-pattern and leaf-gold tarot border.
Style/medium: exquisite detailed hand-painted fantasy tarot illustration, serene symbolic realism, opaque RGB full scene.
Lighting/mood: release, renewal, thaw, quiet dignity.
Color palette: frost blue, bud green, luminous white, restrained stone gray and pale gold.
Constraints: exactly one white stag, one subtle skull only, credible walking contact, visually clear left-dormant/right-thriving division, no duplicated animal.
Avoid: additional deer, ghost deer, animal formed from the skull, people, gore, blood, disaster, battle, fire, skeleton figure, floating hooves, broken road, text, title, letters, numbers, watermark, logo.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass coarse visual check; no transparent layers, assembly, or formal review.
